messages.content: Why do people hide their true feelings?

A person may conceal the truth even from himself. He fears the judgment of others, yet perhaps fears his own judgment even more. And so he builds a wall around his heart, then wonders why he feels alone.

Guilt is a strange companion. It follows a person into silence, into solitude, into the moments when there is no audience left to deceive. Sometimes the punishment begins long before anyone discovers the crime.
